newsitem.title: PERU: Peru rebels release four hostages in siege.
newsitem.headline: Peru rebels release four hostages in siege.

text.p: Peruvian rebels holding about 400 hostages at the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima released four captives at 6 p.m. (2300 GMT) on Thursday.
Three Red Cross officials accompanied the four men out of the compound. They walked slowly and looked dazed.
The four men, all dressed in suits and accompanied by police, were driven away in an unidentified black car through a waiting crowd of journalists and onlookers.
The released men were not immediately identified.
The guerrillas, who began talks on Thursday with the Red Cross, have threatened to kill the hostages if up to 500 of their jailed comrades are not released.
